recommended_path: Recommended: A
paths_available: A) Obtain written permission for a dated official team chart; B) license a provider with explicit model-use rights; C) defer rank and keep it blank.
why_recommended: None of A-C can proceed on official data until depth-chart rights are known. C is the only zero-risk default and costs nothing while D04 is open.
main_trade_off: No official NFL depth chart exists at the tested URL (404); roster pages expose position and status only.

recommended_path: Recommended: A then B fallback
paths_available: A) Request licensed historical NFL results and box-score access; B) use a provider with explicit archive/model rights; C) keep history blank and publish links only.
why_recommended: This is the single largest unblocking item: no sample means no validation, no correlation and no skill measurement.
main_trade_off: Scale and rights are both unknown; a public page is not an archive licence.

recommended_path: Recommended: A
paths_available: A) Request a written licensed quote and reuse terms; B) compare authorised providers; C) keep price fields blank.
why_recommended: Without prices no line can be graded or compared, and closing-line value is undefined.
main_trade_off: Market coverage, timestamp granularity and derived-use rights vary by provider.

recommended_path: Recommended: C until D01 closes
paths_available: A) Obtain permission and define retention; B) licence an authorised historical feed; C) source links only, no archived versions.
why_recommended: Status movement within a week is the most useful injury signal, but archiving is exactly what the terms restrict.
main_trade_off: Archiving without permission is the highest-risk version of this project's current data posture.

recommended_path: Recommended: B
paths_available: A) Filters only for authorised fields; B) export only project metadata, never NFL rows; C) defer export.
why_recommended: Filters are safe and already implemented; bulk NFL export would reproduce the dataset and is not authorised.
main_trade_off: Export is a redistribution act, not a display act.

recommended_path: Recommended: B, now delivered
paths_available: A) Keep everything in COORDINATION.md; B) add a decision page when more than one reviewer must choose.
why_recommended: Multiple open gates now need an owner and a written answer, so traceability has outgrown a log file.
main_trade_off: Duplication between board and site if both drift.

recommended_path: Recommended: A only with a licensed feed
paths_available: A) Scheduled job on a licensed feed; B) manual source links, no copying; C) no refresh until rights clear.
why_recommended: A working refresh needs both a permission and a feed; either alone is insufficient.
main_trade_off: Automating retrieval of a public page is the specific act the terms prohibit.

recommended_path: Recommended: A
paths_available: A) Pre-register with a statistician once data access is approved; B) publish method without a ranking; C) defer the leaderboard.
why_recommended: Pre-registration is what makes a later 'pass' meaningful rather than fitted to the results seen.
main_trade_off: Criteria chosen before the market and sample exist may need amendment, which must itself be logged.

recommended_path: Recommended: A, after D02/D03
paths_available: A) Define a prospective window after data and legal gates; B) require untouched out-of-time evaluation; C) publish no leaderboard until tests exist.
why_recommended: This is the only design in the repository that can show skill rather than a backtest fit.
main_trade_off: A prospective window is still a finite sample; variance is reduced, never removed.

recommended_path: Recommended: A first
paths_available: A) Jurisdiction-specific advice before any feature; B) stay no-stakes and reward-free; C) do not launch the feature.
why_recommended: Choosing A or C before building avoids designing a reward that later cannot be offered.
main_trade_off: Advice is jurisdiction- and mechanic-specific; one opinion will not cover every market.

topic: Separate skill from luck with an explicit variance baseline
recommended_path: Proposed, not implemented
paths_available: A) Pre-register a noise-only baseline (coin-flip / market-implied) and require the strategy to beat it out-of-sample; B) report every result with an uncertainty interval and the number of comparisons made; C) do neither and publish no ranking.
why_recommended: The brief asks to remove luck. The defensible version is measuring performance against a noise baseline with uncertainty, not deleting variance.
main_trade_off: A baseline can be chosen to flatter a strategy; it must be fixed before results are seen.

recommended_path: Proposed, not implemented
paths_available: A) Split the exposure table by label type (injury versus not-injury-related/resting/coaching decision); B) treat all Out rows as equivalent; C) publish no split.
why_recommended: The verified data already contains rows such as 'Not injury related - resting player'. Counting those as injury-driven deficiency overstates the signal.
main_trade_off: Grouping them together inflates the apparent injury impact.

recommended_path: A) Static page generated from data/decision-chain.csv

why_recommended: All fields already exist and are verified; a static page cannot drift from the data because the builder generates it.
main_trade_off: One more nav page to maintain.

recommended_path: Recommended: A (rank on signal, show staking beside it) - already the current behaviour
paths_available: A) rank on signal, show staking beside; B) blended score; C) leave to the reader

topic: Player-prop research gated on a rights-cleared source
recommended_path: Recommended: C (defer), or B at most
recommendation_strength: Strong - publishing prop numbers without official outcomes and settlement rules would be manufacturing findings
paths_available: A) licence a prop source; B) research market structure only, publish no numbers; C) defer
why_recommended: No player-prop outcomes, prices or settlement rules exist in this repository, so no prop correlation or strategy can be computed honestly.
main_trade_off: Props stay the largest blank area of the brief for longer.
current_evidence_state: No prop data of any kind. Flag F31; decision D03.

topic: Licensed odds feed for opening and closing prices
recommended_path: Recommended: A (licence a provider with explicit model-use rights), and do not start until the data-rights question D01 is answered
recommendation_strength: Strong - it unblocks the most blocked item in the whole project
paths_available: A) licence a provider with explicit model-use rights; B) capture a written research snapshot only; C) defer and keep prices blank
why_recommended: Every market measurement the brief asks for - price snapshots, closing-line value, ROI, staking results - depends on this one input, and nothing else can substitute for it.
main_trade_off: Cost and licence terms, against finally being able to measure whether the originated lines are any good.
current_evidence_state: No price source. 919 of 919 market cells across four files are blank. Flag F07; decision D02.

recommended_path: Recommended: A (scheduled capture), but only after S29 is in place
paths_available: A) scheduled capture per game at kickoff; B) manual capture; C) defer
why_recommended: Closing-line value is the standard test of whether an originated line beats the market, and it is undefined without a closing number.
main_trade_off: A missed capture produces a blank that is indistinguishable from 'no data available'.
current_evidence_state: Column reserved and blank. Flag F07.
